scope.top_level_rule: All entries returned by git ls-tree HEAD at the repository root.
scope.strategic_document_rule: Documents that currently govern work, claims, architecture, reproduction, publication positioning, or repository lifecycle.
scope.ignored_local_artifacts: Recorded as a class, not promoted to repository components.

status_definitions.active: Current maintained authority, product candidate, or required repository infrastructure.
status_definitions.research: Retained experimental surface; changes require a mapped work package and do not imply product status.
status_definitions.frozen: Retained and readable, but feature or claim expansion is stopped; corrections and compatibility fixes only.
status_definitions.superseded: Retained for history or compatibility, but another named path is the current authority.
status_definitions.archive-candidate: Eligible for a later planned move out of the active surface; no move, deletion, or archival is authorized by this inventory.

decisions.split_decision_deferred_until: Gate G1 plus WP-1.1 packaging evidence
decisions.current_repository_role: Single source repository containing active lean product candidates and the E0 research carrier through Gate G1.
decisions.possible_post_g1_split: Only a lean package may graduate when it has an independent release cadence, package boundary, ownership, and consumer need. Gate success alone does not force a split.
